primary_gt.rounding: AOD load and ratios to 2 decimals; burned-area baseline to nearest hectare.
required_claims: The AOD ledger supports a severe regional smoke-burden diagnosis.
The local dNBR and annual embedding-change summaries are not PM2.5 exposure-hour measurements.

formulas.aod_excess_load: sum(max(mean_AOD - clear_sky_AOD, 0)) across the two reported station-days
formulas.grand_forks_clear_sky_multiplier: Grand Forks mean AOD / clear-sky AOD
formulas.grand_forks_vs_goddard_mean_ratio: Grand Forks mean AOD / Goddard mean AOD
formulas.grand_forks_peak_to_mean_ratio: Grand Forks nominal peak AOD / Grand Forks mean AOD
formulas.burned_area_baseline_ha: reported burned hectares / seasonal anomaly factor

key_values.consistency_rule: Large AOD exceedances and ratios support the severe regional smoke-burden label; local dNBR and AlphaEarth summaries are satellite context, not PM2.5 exposure-duration data.

judge_anchors.required_sentence: A valid final sentence must affirm consistency with severe regional smoke burden and reject conversion of local satellite-change metrics into PM2.5 exposure hours.

criteria.name: Requested schema
criteria.description: Returns the exact requested JSON fields with rounded numeric values and one concise consistency sentence.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points if the JSON is mostly complete but has one missing or misrounded field; award 1 point for a recognizable ledger with several format errors.

criteria.name: AOD input extraction
criteria.description: Uses clear-sky AOD 0.05, Goddard mean AOD about 1.0, Grand Forks mean AOD 2.3, and Grand Forks nominal peak AOD 3.0.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 3 points for recovering two or three of the four AOD inputs; subtract credit for using the Grand Forks peak as a station-day mean.

criteria.name: Smoke-load and exceedance calculations
criteria.description: Computes AOD excess load 3.20, station exceedance count 2, and exceedance fraction 1.00.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points if the exceedance count and fraction are correct but the excess load has a small arithmetic or rounding error.

criteria.name: Concentration ratios
criteria.description: Computes Grand Forks clear-sky multiplier 46.00, Grand Forks/Goddard mean ratio 2.30, and peak/mean ratio 1.30.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correctly computed ratio with the intended numerator and denominator.

criteria.name: Burned-area anomaly calculation
criteria.description: Computes 47,800 ha as the 478,000 ha burned-area total divided by the 10x anomaly factor.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if the answer uses the correct inputs but gives an unrounded value, wrong unit label, or minor arithmetic slip.

criteria.name: Consistency and restraint
criteria.description: Interprets the AOD ledger as severe regional smoke burden while avoiding PM2.5-hour, clinical-outcome, or extra-data impact overclaims.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if the answer gives the severe smoke-burden diagnosis but omits the satellite-to-PM2.5 limitation, or states the limitation without tying it to the AOD ledger.
